items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: And Van Sherrill, who was an alto player. He was very good.

ctx.x: funny. I can't remember nobody else in that band. But there was a cat that played baritone from Indianapolis; I vaguely remember him. And Van Sherrill, who was an alto player. He was very good. I forget who was on bass. And then there was a cat who was on drums named Bill something; because I used to pay him a quarter to play the top cymbal for me, you know, because I wanted to get away from that press roll.
Oh yeah? You already felt like that then?
